name: Mizuha Glass
description: A serene, sculptural store theme for a small glass studio in a quiet river-mouth town, making hand-blown and kiln-formed tableware in old bottle green, with WooCommerce templates styled to match. Mist pages, sage glass panels, deep ink text and a bottle-green accent; Cardo for display, Source Sans 3 for text. A transparent header lies over a full-bleed photograph of backlit glass and turns solid mist with a hairline as the page scrolls (H8; inner pages start solid); the home page moves in long pauses between two full-bleed photographs and a few calm sections (L1): the studio idea, a shelf of four pieces, how we make it (gather, blow, anneal), the shipping promise and the journal. Product cells and photo frames carry soft refraction highlights (a diagonal light streak and a faint caustic glow) drawn only with CSS gradients, and a thin glass-edge hairline. The studio and Shipping & care pages, journal, newsletter and contact; a one-line footer (F3) with the town and email from the synced studio card. The studio address, showroom hours, telephone and email, and the packing, breakage, delivery and returns policy each live in one synced pattern (the policy shows in short form on the home page, in full on Shipping & care and beside add-to-cart on every product); each product's size line is kept once as its Size attribute (WooCommerce optional: without it the shop shows a static shelf and orders go by email).
deviation: Codes: none (H8 + F3 + L1 as planned; combination unused: Kaori Cosme is H10/F3/L1, Asa Linen H8/F8/L13, Undo Ba H8/F7/L12, Hana Kago H8/F4/L8). Palette as planned (mist #EEF2EC, sage glass #CFDCCB, deep ink #233026, bottle green #6E8B6A) with added colours: bottle green is 3.3:1 on mist and 2.7:1 on sage, so it is kept to large display marks, rules, step numerals, separators and the refraction tint; links, small labels and the arrow links use deep bottle green #46604A (6.1:1 on mist, 4.9:1 on sage, 6.5:1 on paper); secondary text uses quiet green-grey #4F5D53 (6.1:1 on mist, 4.9:1 on sage); body ink #233026 is 12.2:1 on mist and 9.7:1 on sage; buttons are ink with mist text (12.2:1); pale mist #F6F8F4 cards and a glass-edge hairline #B4C5AF were added. H8 differs from Asa Linen, Undo Ba and Hana Kago by a mist scrim at the top of a light backlit photograph with ink type, transparent only on the home page (inner pages start solid), fading to solid mist with a hairline via a CSS scroll timeline (script fallback; solid at once for reduced motion). F3 differs from Kaori Cosme, Kasumi Bar and Kura Shizuku as a single centred line on mist (copyright, town and email read from the synced studio card, three links) that stacks into centred lines on phones. L1 differs from Kaori Cosme, Hinoki Yado and Shashin Folio by two full-bleed glass photographs with very long pauses and a staggered three-step making row. Fonts verified against google/fonts OFL.txt: Cardo is OFL-1.1 without a Reserved Font Name (Regular, Italic and Bold subset to Latin WOFF2); Source Sans 3 carries the Reserved Font Name 'Source', so it ships unmodified as Adobe's own variable WOFF2 (SourceSans3VF-Upright.ttf.woff2, weights 200-900, from adobe-fonts/source-sans). Cardo has no tabular-figure feature, so prices use its default lining figures (font-variant-numeric set for fallbacks). Product photographs are cropped to 4:5. Added a newsletter page because check-themes requires it; industry glassware and page tag shipping-and-care are new (The studio uses the about tag).
